name: [🐲] MOUNT RNG
desc:
🐲 MOUNT RNG 🐲
Roll for 600+ unique mounts, explore wild islands, and battle fierce beasts!

🎃 UPDATE 54 IS LIVE! 🎃
New content drops EVERY 2 WEEKS, so there's always something fresh to roll for!

🎲 HOW TO PLAY 🎲
- Roll for mounts, from common steeds to ultra-rare legends
- Move across islands and discover new areas
- Fight enemies and prove your mount is the strongest
- Complete your collection: 700+ mounts and counting!

🍀 BOOST YOUR LUCK 🍀
- 👥 +5 Luck for EVERY friend in your server (stacks!)
- 👍 Like the game, join the group & turn on notifications for +20 Luck

📅 Version 1.55
